reviews.text: Hi Teresa, thank you so much for your review. 🖤🤎🩶 …
Liars. Google Maps says you treat wild animals, but when I called to ask if you treated birds, the answer was no. What wild animals do you treat then? Lions?

Well, the space is complete, but my recent experiences haven't been good. The exams don't come out on time. They say it's because of 'Simples Pet,' but I've complained more than once that one of my pets isn't in the system, and nothing changes. I had an X-ray done on my pet, and to this day I haven't received any feedback because they simply can't find the exam, and I paid for it. I always took my pets there, but I'll probably change places because I haven't had any positive feedback.

The lady who does the bathing always leaves them spotless, and that's what saves this place. I'm disappointed and don't intend to go back for consultations and exams.

The clinic has some good vets. However, the reception is simply awful. One receptionist left me talking to myself, took the phone off the line, and continued talking to and charging other clients. Terrible service. I'm only not giving it a 0 because I can't comment.
Thank you so much for your review! 🖤🤎🩶 …

I had a good experience with the dentist, the oncologist, and the surgeon, all in the pre-operative phase. However, in the post-operative phase, I felt neglected in my needs. My canine pet, Jade, is 16 years old and this was her first surgery in 15 years. I have no experience with post-operative care. When I contacted the clinic via WhatsApp, I didn't receive a quick or efficient response, which culminated in an emergency visit to a 24-hour clinic in the middle of the night. This assessment was reported to the clinic's customer service department, and I am awaiting a response. I should add that the biopsy results, which assess whether the tumor is malignant or benign, are not yet ready; it will be a month since Jade had the surgery to remove it. I was informed that it would take between 15 and 20 business days.
CVVM is wonderful. The service is quick, attentive, detailed, and I always feel very safe. I highly recommend it, especially Dr. Caio Gustavo and Dr. Bruna Mietto, they are exceptional!
Hi, thank you so much for your review, José. 🖤🤎🩶 …

Excellent place, Dr. André Schiller and his medical team are extraordinary, excellent, knowledgeable, and attentive professionals, they deserve praise. The receptionists are attentive and efficient, my pet was very well taken care of, I can only thank them! I highly recommend this exceptional place and people!
Excellent service. I recommend it!
Excellent service. They have their own laboratory. I highly recommend them.
Excellent place with wonderful professionals. The service from Dr. Bruna, Dr. Caio, and Dr. Marília was top-notch! The receptionists were also always excellent.
Good

Fantastic! Dr. Gabriel and his team were always very attentive, showing great care for the patients and demonstrating technical knowledge when guiding the pet owners during the consultation. Our pet's surgery was a success and we are very satisfied with our choice!

The veterinarians are good!

But the reception staff couldn't be worse!!

1) More than once they scheduled the wrong exam for my dog, causing her unnecessary suffering!

2) The results of the last exams came back BLANK! Without any information!

3) They take days and days to respond to scheduling via WhatsApp…
4) When we're at reception: they start attending to us and then suddenly leave, leaving us standing there talking to a wall without explaining anything… that's why they schedule things incorrectly! Because they don't pay attention to anything we say!

A disappointment!!!
Good team and very attentive.
Excellent service. Dr. Bárbara was very attentive, and I felt confident in her guidance.

Dr. Mariana is WONDERFUL!
A top-notch hematologist, she was absolutely right about my brunette!

I take my two dogs there, and they are always treated well with attention and affection. Dr. Nicole is great.
One of them has already been to the dentist and had her tartar cleaned.

My experience at the veterinary clinic was excellent. From the very first appointment, I was received with great care, organization, and professionalism. The clinic's structure is impeccable: a clean, well-equipped, comfortable environment that inspires a lot of confidence.

I would like to give special thanks to Dr. André and Dr. Sandra, who cared for my Lana and demonstrated exceptional knowledge, great dedication, and, above all, genuine care for animals. They explain everything clearly, are attentive, patient, and treat each pet with great respect and affection, which makes all the difference.

I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking excellent veterinary care. My sincere congratulations to the entire team for their professionalism, welcoming atmosphere, and the quality of services provided!

I took my kitten there for the first time on June 4th and I found the service excellent. I loved Dr. Mariana who attended to us and I bet she loved the kitten too, hahaha… A tip is to go (if possible) on a weekday, on Saturdays any place gets a little more crowded, but even so the service was great.
We were seen by orthopedist Dr. Gabriel and we loved the service. He was super attentive and careful. We recommend him!
Very good. Excellent veterinary oncologist, Dr. Veronica...
Hi Mariano!! Thank you so much for your feedback.

I have rarely been to a place with such good service. My dog ​​is 13 years old. With age comes the consequences of old age. He had a more serious problem in the past and received excellent care at this center. Because of the service, we now do all our follow-up with the professionals at this vet. And it's incredible how good their selection is. Starting with Bruna, then Wesley (cardiology), and now Veronica (oncology), they are all very attentive veterinarians, clear in their explanations, and very professional. I highly recommend this veterinary center.
Attentive and competent veterinarians.

Hello! We are very happy to know that you had a good experience with us 💙

Thank you for your feedback and for trusting our work.

Count on us whenever you need us.

Sincerely, Vila Mariana Veterinary Center

I was seen by veterinarian Mariana, and she was excellent, very careful, attentive, caring, and meticulous with my cat. However, what makes me give it 4 stars is the reception, which I didn't find so good. And when I informed her that the veterinarian had requested an urgent test for my cat the next day as soon as the clinic opened, she simply said they didn't have it and didn't seem concerned, even though it was an emergency.
Excellent service and everyone was attentive.
Excellent

Count on us whenever you need us.

Impeccable service, Dr. André is an excellent professional. The place accepts the PetLove plan and also private patients. Imaging exams and similar procedures can be performed there, in addition to consultations. However, it should be noted that parking is a bit difficult as spaces are limited.
Excellent veterinarian
Excellent professionals, personalized service, pleasant and clean environment. I highly recommend it.

I want to thank veterinarian Dr. Caio Silva for the procedure he performed today with extreme care, responsibility, and in a very loving way for my cat, who is terminally ill at 18 years old. A great professional who takes the weight off my shoulders at such a delicate moment. Thank you!

Hello! We are very happy to know that you had a good experience with us 💙

Thank you for your feedback and for trusting our work.

Count on us whenever you need us.

Sincerely, Vila Mariana Veterinary Center
Very attentive staff. From the receptionists to the veterinarians.

I have no words to thank the entire team at this clinic, especially veterinarian Bruna Mietto, who has been lovingly caring for our dogs for many years. Without her, we wouldn't have been able to get through this stage so successfully. She helped me anticipate all the procedures and also gave me psychological support during moments of great anguish. Maya (our dog) needed availability for exams, consultations, and emergency surgery. She was very well treated by everyone, everything went well, and she is already recovering very well at home! Thank you Maria Clara (the vet in the infirmary who took such good care of Maya), Dr. Gabriel (for making room in such a difficult schedule), and Sandra (who authorized all these changes so that the surgery could take place). Congratulations on the beautiful and serious work you do!

Disappointing service for those expecting continuity and common sense.

I have been a client of the clinic for years and have always trusted the team to care for my dogs precisely because of their history and the relationship built over time.

Unfortunately, this trust was lost in a recent episode (January 29, 2026).

I needed a renewal of a prescription for continuous use, with a known history and existing documentation.

What should have been a simple process turned into a whole day of delays, internal misalignment, staff changes mid-service, and contradictory answers. In the end, I received excessively rigid, unempathetic communication, incompatible with the years-long relationship that existed.

The point here is not the existence of rules, but the inability to analyze the context, the patient's history, and handle the situation with clarity and common sense.

The irony is that I resolved the problem quickly at another nearby clinic, precisely because they listened, understood the case, and were willing to help.

It's a shame to realize that a well-structured clinic fails precisely in what's most important: relationship, consistency, and continuity of care.

After this episode, I chose to continue with another professional.

Hello! We are very happy to know that you had a good experience with us 💙

Thank you for your feedback and for trusting our work.

Count on us whenever you need us.

Sincerely, Vila Mariana Veterinary Center

On January 24th, at 3 PM, I had a somewhat unpleasant experience when contacting the clinic for a neurological evaluation related to a possible head surgery for my pet, who has a tumor. I was surprised by the veterinarian, who said she wasn't sure if the clinic performed this type of procedure. However, in a previous contact via WhatsApp, I was informed that the place offered this service.

Therefore, I ended up going to the appointment without any clarity about the availability of a neurology specialist. I consider that there was a lack of preparation on the part of the clinic, which made me feel insecure while waiting for the veterinarian's confirmation about the existence of a specialist for the surgery.

Furthermore, I noticed that the receptionist seemed unwilling to assist, conveying the feeling that she didn't want to be there. I believe this type of conduct also deserves attention, as those at reception should always be receptive, with a welcoming and cordial attitude, since it is the clients' first contact with the clinic.

Overall, I wasted time and resources, as I traveled a long distance and the appointment took up a slot in the schedule that could have been used for another patient.

I suggest that the clinic more carefully evaluate both the initial communication and the reception staff's demeanor to avoid similar situations in the future and provide greater security and confidence to pet owners and their animals.

I went to the Vila Mariana Veterinary Center to have my dog ​​microchipped as required by the Pet Love health plan, and I received excellent service. From scheduling onwards, everything was easy and quick, with an appointment available the day after I contacted them. I arrived 10 minutes early as requested and was promptly attended to by the veterinarian, Dr. Caio. The microchip implantation is very quick and apparently painless, as my German Spitz puppy didn't cry or seem sore afterward. The consultation lasted about 5 minutes, with all the information provided clearly. I haven't needed any specific health-related care for my dog ​​yet, but I recommend the center for microchipping.
Thank you so much for your feedback. It means a lot to us. 💙 …
I loved the experience at the clinic. I especially thank Dr. Bruna, who was very attentive to Chica Maria and answered all our questions.

Hi Lígia, how are you?

Thank you so much for your feedback. I've sent it to our team.
The receptionist was very rude. I have no complaints about the veterinarians, but the receptionist was very abrupt and the service was poor.
Hi, thank you so much for your great review. 💙 …

First of all, I'd like to start this review by saying that I've worked in veterinary clinic reception and am familiar with customer service.

My experience with the clinic has been very positive! I moved to São Paulo this year, so I wanted to find a clinic close to home to follow up with my 10-year-old cat who has kidney failure.

I had consultations with specialists covered by the Petlove plan: a dentist and a nephrologist. They all treated me very well, explained everything very clearly, and answered all my questions! My cat needed a periodontal procedure plus a serious extraction. The whole process was a bit slow because the specialists only see patients on specific days of the week, and the client list is long, so sometimes it takes a while to find an appointment (this isn't a criticism; I completely understand that they do everything to serve everyone as best and as quickly as possible).

My cat underwent a series of tests, all done at the clinic itself (all covered by the Petlove plan): blood tests, electrocardiogram, ultrasound, etc. We received excellent service from the professionals who assisted us with the blood draws and exams! The results also come out very quickly through SimplesPet!

She had the procedure today (with the PetLove plan) and needed to have 3 teeth extracted! She was very well taken care of and the procedure was very quick. I soon received an audio message from the veterinarian who treated her, explaining the case and providing the necessary instructions. She answered all my questions! Thank you so much to Dr. Aryane and her team for taking such good care of my kitten!

I have other follow-up exams scheduled throughout this month and a return visit with the specialist next month as well!

To the reception staff: I congratulate you on your kindness and politeness throughout the service. A few days ago I received a message on WhatsApp saying they were experiencing instability, which was causing some delays in responses. This sometimes made me a little anxious, so I decided to go to the clinic to have my questions answered in person (I live very close by). I may have come across as a difficult customer, so I apologize if I gave that impression :) But I only have praise for everyone's in-person and virtual service, so congratulations to the whole team! Oh, I especially commend them for their care for the cats. Since the reception area is shared with dogs as well, the reception staff are always kind enough to move us to a small room to wait in and keep the cats less stressed, showing great care for our pets!
✨🌟
Excellent service

The clinic has a very attentive and competent team. The orthopedics department, which treated Theo, deserves special mention—caring professionals with excellent technical knowledge, always willing to explain everything clearly. I was very happy with the service and the care they showed him.
Excellent veterinarians!!!

I had an emergency with my dog ​​and arrived close to closing time. My dog ​​received excellent care; everyone was very kind – reception, nurse, and veterinarian. They instilled a lot of confidence in me. I appreciate the care and affection shown by Festa!
Impeccable service. Attentive and absolutely amazing!
I really like the clinic and Dr. Bruna. Excellent veterinarian, super caring!!
Excellent veterinary center; whenever my poodle Thiago is sick, they are always ready to help me. I recommend them to everyone.

I wouldn't recommend them to anyone. They refused to treat my dog ​​even though it was an emergency. He was very ill and I was alone, in an Uber. They didn't call, the vet and receptionist simply said they didn't have any appointments available, and I had to return by Uber with my sick dog.

EDIT: After publishing my review, the clinic contacted me several times requesting that I remove it, which is inappropriate conduct and contrary to the consumer's right to report their own experience.

Furthermore, the clinic's public response was personal and offensive, with judgments and distortions about what happened.

I regret that, instead of acting with professionalism and empathy, they opted for a defensive stance. My intention was always only to report my real experience, based on verifiable facts and documented communications.

=======

My experience with the Vila Mariana Veterinary Center was extremely disappointing. I am leaving this account to warn other clients about the disorganization and lack of transparency I encountered at this clinic.

First point: the reception service is disastrous. The information is confusing, there are delays in responding on WhatsApp, and even when they do respond, the answer often has no relation to what was asked. I requested a time sheet several times to justify my absence from work and have not yet received an adequate response. I will need to request it again, which demonstrates the lack of organization in the service. It makes no sense to offer a digital channel that doesn't fulfill the basics.

Second point: incorrect billing. I submitted the exam form in advance, clearly stating that there would be two biopsies, gastric and intestinal. Even so, the clinic only charged one, and only corrected it because I questioned it. The solution offered was to add a second anesthesia, which makes no sense, since the complete procedure was described from the beginning. Result: incorrect charge on my card. Only after much insistence did they admit the error, but even then I had to closely monitor to ensure that the refund would actually be processed. This type of failure cannot happen in a medical environment, where clarity and trust are essential.

Third point: my cat came out of surgery with a wound on her head that wasn't there before. I questioned the clinic and the response was evasive, claiming that it didn't seem to be recent. I have photos that prove the wound didn't exist before the procedure. This attitude of not taking responsibility only increased my dissatisfaction and distrust. Furthermore, after the surgery, they tried to charge me for items I had already provided myself, such as surgical clothing and medication. I had to refuse immediately. This type of practice gives the impression that the priority is not the animal's well-being or the client's experience, but only the collection of extra fees.

I acknowledge that the veterinarians who treated my cat were attentive during the surgery, but this does not eliminate the lack of organization, the absence of efficient communication, and the administrative errors committed. The result is a frustrated client who feels disrespected and deceived.

My cat still needs to return to have her stitches removed, but after that, I never intend to use this clinic's services again. It is regrettable to have to go through all this at an already delicate time, when what is expected is trust, professionalism, and compassion.

I leave this record here so that the clinic reflects on the need to improve processes, train its staff, and, above all, respect the client and their animals. Mistakes happen, but evasive justifications and a lack of transparency only make the situation worse.
